dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you still remember what happened before?

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Of course I remember! I'll never forget! You helped Aino catch me.

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: I used to be a carefree prospector bot, doing whatever I pleased. Now I'm slaving away sorting out garbage!
